create_action_noise_wrapper: create a Wrapper instance to add Gaussian noise to a dm_control environment's actions
run_noisy_step: run a step on the wrapped environment that applies clipped Gaussian noise to the action
reset_wrapped_env: reset the underlying dm_control environment through the action noise wrapper
review_wrapper_bounds_check: review the Wrapper init to understand how it validates finite action bounds
summarize_noise_scale: summarize how the Wrapper computes noise standard deviation as a fraction of the action range
